title: Whose brand goes on the app and the PDF?
bluf: The SOW says 'Branded PDF' without naming whose brand. Two tickets wait on it: the branding source (21) and the self-branding, metrics scope and revenue-calculator inputs (396). The design also hot-links an external logo, which we never ship. Recommend we keep the neutral placeholder brand until the owner and assets are named; the swap point is one brand style file. Default if you do not tap: option C, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-21, HPSMPOC-396

options.label: Neutral placeholder for now
options.detail: No change to what is built.

default_action: Option C: keep the neutral placeholder.
